# 07 Morph

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** An element in A changes, through in-between frames, into a different element in B.

**Test.** Is something visibly one thing at the start and another thing at the end?

**Not here.** No in-between frames makes it 01 Cut › Match Cut. If the element keeps its identity and leads the eye, it is 08 Carry.

**Build.** Needs both scenes, so it is built inside scene code (@remotion/paths interpolatePath, mesh warps).

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Shape](shape/) | One vector shape interpolates into another. | circle → square, icon → icon |
| [Type](type/) | Letters or words change into other letters, words or shapes. | word swap, letter → logo |
| [Object](object/) | A depicted object becomes another object. | cup → planet |
| [Image Morph](image-morph/) | Whole images warp into each other via corresponding points. | face morph |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Frame Morph](shape/frame-morph/) | Shape | The whole frame rounds and shrinks into a circle, the picture inside becomes the new scene, and the circle grows back into the full frame. |
| [Type Morph](type/type-morph/) | Type | A word melts into another word with a gooey liquid morph while the scene behind changes. |
| [Blob Morph](object/blob-morph/) | Object | The frame collapses into a wobbling liquid blob, which turns into the new scene and swells back to fill the frame. |
